content: {"episode_id":"ep-05044","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 for missing prior authorization based on the documented clinical indication. The patient has recurrent syncope and near-syncope in the setting of known atrial fibrillation, raising concern for intermittent high-grade conduction disease or symptomatic arrhythmia. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these transient symptoms with underlying rhythm disturbances and guide further management."}
